published.source: Shaman regear round (2026-10-23): the 8% melee cap (neck hit to crit); requests rebuilt from the presets with the natural flask zone

summary: Enhancement with Mana Tide Totem for the group, cast at 20% mana. Magma Totem rotation, with Lightning Shield kept up.
rotation: Pre-pull: Strength of Earth IV at -5.5s, Windfury Totem at -4.5s, Mana Spring at -3.5s, Lightning Shield at -2.5s, Magma Totem at -1s
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20s left
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less; Mana Spring waits until the tide ends
Magma Totem when it is down and at least 2s remain
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it; other cooldowns
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Earth Shock while Flame Shock has more than 1s left
Fire Nova above 20% mana (after the shocks)
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Mana Tide Totem is worth about 0.1 for the shaman itself.
Water Shield does nothing: Lightning Shield stays ahead.
Assumed: Maelstrom Weapon procs at 2 PPM per point, until the beta reaches level 34.
Elemental Focus triggers: if Stormstrike can trigger it, Enhancement gets too few Clearcasting procs.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate.
Fire Nova uses the 70425 values: coefficient 0.143, rank 5 base 232 to 259.
The raid's second shaman's Flametongue Totem holds the weapon's totem slot next to our Windfury Weapon (user ruling 2026-10-16, assumed; to verify in game): +18 to +19 at 180 s
Relic: Burning Totem, its own gear set: Totem of the Storm is 0.1 to 1.5 behind here.
notes: mksettings -spec enh -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_burning_totem -apl mana_tide -talents 03-055030031005112051-053051001001 -race Orc -duration 180 -level 60 (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totems are a second shaman's Grace of Air and Flametongue Totem, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring Totem and Magma Totem itself).
